text: Novelist James Foster and his wife Em are on holiday in Li Tolqa when [a fan named Gabi coaxes them beyond the resort grounds|trigger|an outsider reaches in]. Driving back drunk, James kills a local man. The country lets foreigners [pay to have a copy of themselves executed in their place|rules|everything has a price], and James watches his double die at a stake. Gabi's circle of tourists, [who return each year to watch their doubles slaughtered|wrong|exploitation for profit], [draws him into their games for their own amusement|wants|cruelty and destruction].
